# truenas_audit_config (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS audit configuration. Takes no arguments: there is exactly one audit configuration per TrueNAS system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled_services` (Attributes) Summary of what is currently being audited per service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enabled_services))
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "audit_config".
- `quota` (Number) Size in GiB of the maximum amount of space that may be consumed by the dataset where the audit databases are stored.
- `quota_fill_critical` (Number) Percentage used of dataset quota at which to generate a critical alert.
- `quota_fill_warning` (Number) Percentage used of dataset quota at which to generate a warning alert.
- `remote_logging_enabled` (Boolean) Whether logging to a remote syslog server is enabled on TrueNAS, and audit logs are included in what is sent remotely.
- `reservation` (Number) Size in GiB of refreservation set on the ZFS dataset where the audit databases are stored.
- `retention` (Number) Number of days to retain local audit messages.
- `space` (Attributes) ZFS dataset space accounting for where the audit databases are stored, in bytes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space))

<a id="nestedatt--enabled_services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `enabled_services`

Read-Only:

- `middleware` (List of String) Middleware audit event types that are currently enabled.
- `smb` (List of String) SMB share names for which auditing is currently enabled.
- `sudo` (List of String) Sudo commands or users currently being audited.


<a id="nestedatt--space"></a>
### Nested Schema for `space`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Number) Available space remaining for the audit dataset, in bytes.
- `used` (Number) Total space used by the audit dataset, in bytes.
- `used_by_dataset` (Number) Space used by the dataset itself, in bytes.
- `used_by_reservation` (Number) Space reserved for the dataset, in bytes.
- `used_by_snapshots` (Number) Space used by snapshots of the audit dataset, in bytes.
